homepage.hero.card.flip.message: Flip to read the plain-language reading

homepage.hero.card.quote.message: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.

homepage.hero.card.note.message: When your mind keeps rehearsing the worst and the worry keeps growing, ask: right now, in this moment, what is actually happening? Usually it's only the imagination that is on fire.

homepage.hero.card.hint.message: Tap the card for a reading

homepage.hero.lead.message: StoaZen gathers 180 short passages from Zen texts, Stoic philosophy and modern psychology. When something weighs on you, pick what you're facing and draw a card, and let one line help you see it from another angle. When you want to settle, sit for a minute with your breath.

homepage.hero.note.message: Free · Out now on iOS, Android coming soon

homepage.meta.description.message: StoaZen gathers 180 lines of Zen, Stoic and psychological wisdom. Draw a card for what you're facing, sit in quiet meditation, save and track your practice. Out now on the App Store.

homepage.how.step1.body.message: Pick the one of eight life themes closest to how you feel right now. Nothing in particular? Choose Whatever Comes.

homepage.how.step2.body.message: Draw one line from Zen, Stoic philosophy or psychology for that theme. Every card names its author and source.

homepage.how.step3.body.message: Tap the card for the plain-language reading on the back, and bring an old line to bear on where you are today.

homepage.how.title.message: Three steps to a new angle

homepage.themes.anxiety.desc.message: Restless, worrying too much about what's ahead

homepage.themes.procrastination.desc.message: You know what to do but can't start

homepage.themes.decision.desc.message: Not sure which way to go

homepage.themes.impermanence.desc.message: Holding on to what can't be changed

homepage.themes.serendipity.desc.message: Nothing particular — just see what arrives

homepage.themes.lead.message: One line can speak to many situations. Every theme holds at least 15 cards, so there's always one to draw.

homepage.samples.zen.text.message: The ordinary mind is the Way.

homepage.samples.stoic.text.message: Men are disturbed not by the things which happen, but by the opinions about the things.

homepage.samples.psychology.text.message: The curious paradox is that when I accept myself just as I am, then I can change.

homepage.schools.lead.message: 60 each from Zen, Stoic philosophy and modern psychology, drawn from public-domain classics and short quotable passages. Every card comes in English and Chinese, with author, source and a plain-language reading.

homepage.features.draw.body.message: Draw by theme with no daily limit, and no content locked behind levels. Draw a card you've seen before and it's marked Again.

homepage.features.sit.body.message: Three practices — Breath, Count and Just Sitting — at the length you choose. No voice, no music, just an ink circle rising and falling with your breath.

homepage.features.saved.body.message: Save the lines that land, then filter by theme or school, or search quotes and authors.

homepage.features.progress.body.message: A calendar marks the cards you drew and the times you sat each day, and shows which theme you drew for most this month.

homepage.features.cardStyles.body.message: Drawing, reading and saving earn XP. Level up to unlock eight card styles, from Rice Paper and Ink Wash to Bamboo Slip and Gold Leaf.

homepage.features.reminder.body.message: Pick a time and a theme, and get one line a day as a notification. Tap it to open the full card.

homepage.features.share.body.message: Turn a card you love into an image and share it with friends or save it to Photos.

homepage.features.bilingual.body.message: The app and every quote are available in English and Traditional Chinese. Switch any time.

homepage.principles.noGate.body.message: Levels and XP only unlock looks. They never hide a card. When you need one, it's always there.

homepage.principles.noScore.body.message: Sitting earns no XP and has no streak. Settling down shouldn't come with the pressure of breaking a chain.

homepage.principles.localData.title.message: Your data stays on your phone

homepage.principles.localData.body.message: No account needed. Saved cards, progress and settings live only on your device, and after the first download it works offline.

homepage.principles.title.message: What we chose not to build

homepage.download.app.body.message: Draw, meditate, save and track — the full experience. Available on iOS, with Android coming soon.

homepage.download.app.status.message: Out now on iOS · Android coming soon

homepage.download.browser.body.message: Meet one line of wisdom each time you open your browser.

homepage.download.title.message: On your phone and in your browser

homepage.newsletter.lead.message: Leave your email to get new StoaZen articles plus app release and update news. Unsubscribe any time.
